To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we prepared new 7- hydroxyguanine derivatives 2, 3 and compared biological activities with 7-hydroxguanosine 1 and 7-hydroguanine 4. 7-Hydoxyguanine 4 and its derivatives showed antitumor activity against L1210 cells and antiviral activity against RSV. 7-Hydroyguanosine 2 showed anti-proliferative activity on various cancer cell lines.

we prepared new 7- hydroxyguanine derivatives (7-hydroxy-8-oxoguanosine 5'- monophosphate and N 2-tetrahydro-pyranyl-7- hydroxy-guanine) and compared biological activities (antitumor activity against L1210, antiviral activity against RSV and antiproliferative activity on human cell lines) of these derivatives with those acquired previously.
7-hydroxylated guanine derivatives have antitumor activity against mouse leukemia L-1210, and that 7-hydoxyguanosine monophosphate has the strongest anti-proliferative activity among the derivatives.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of new 7- hydroxyguanine derivatives with biological activities.
the synthesis and biological activities of new 7-substituted guanine derivatives.
synthesis of new 7-substituted guanine derivatives and their anti-viral and antitumor activities.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
7-hydroxypurine derivatives have a broad spectrum of biological activities.
biological activities of 6-hydroxyguanin derivatives depend on their structures.
the 7-hydroxyl group of guanine derivatives is a good candidate for an antitumor agent, but the biological activity of each 7-hydroguanosine derivative depends on the structure of the base.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
7-hydroxylated derivatives of guanine and guanine nucleotides are useful for biological study.
7-hydroxypurines are not only useful for the studies on biological functions of guanine derivatives but are also useful as new antitumor drugs.
